domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD, LCM, or other common denominator for unlike fractions.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with matching denominators before subtraction.
Tag for unlike fractional parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as for pure-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that create a fraction such as d/d from one whole.
Do not tag the subtraction step after common denominators are already established.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form without changing its value.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when this rewriting is done before subtraction to make whole-part and fraction-part subtraction possible.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing one whole during subtraction; borrowing is regrouping, not initial normalization.
Do not tag final recombination of already-computed whole and fractional parts into the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the operands are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the subtraction may temporarily produce a negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting operands into subtraction-ready form.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used to resolve a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplification-only or final-answer-formatting-only steps if no subtraction occurs.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as a fraction with the current denominator and adjust the whole part to complete subtraction when the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed whole is rewritten as d/d and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used after an initial subtraction shows the fractional part is too small.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as a plus 0 over a denominator before subtraction.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not require regrouping.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or simplify a zero-fraction expression to an integer or whole-number result.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor after subtraction.
Tag when a result like 0 over d is simplified to 0.
Tag when a whole plus 0 over d expression is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a result in lowest terms if no explicit simplification is performed.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion before subtraction.
Do not tag final recombination into mixed-number form unless reduction or zero-fraction simplification also occurs.
